ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Add a short heading above the cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SectionDescription.helper: Required. Briefly explain how these related offerings help visitors. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Explore related solutions that work well together.

CrossPromotions.label: Cross Promotions
CrossPromotions.helper: Add as many cross-promotion cards as needed. Every saved card is displayed.

Title.helper: Required. Use a short, recognizable name for the related offering. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

Description.helper: Required. Use a phrase or short sentence instead of a long description. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

Icon.helper: Required. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building

CardLink.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. When provided, the whole card becomes a link.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note beneath the cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Not sure where to start? Contact our team.
